gaps.sentence: The hotel offered ___ our room free of charge.
gaps.explanation: offer takes the to-infinitive: offered to upgrade.
fail takes the to-infinitive: failed to meet.

gaps.sentence: It took me ages ___ used to the new keyboard.
gaps.explanation: it takes time + to-infinitive: took me ages to get used to the keyboard.

gaps.sentence: This new timetable will mean ___ earlier trains.
I regret ___ so rude to her at the party.
gaps.explanation: regret + -ing = feel sorry about something you did.

gaps.sentence: They agreed ___ the deadline by a week.
gaps.explanation: 'Agree to do something' takes the to-infinitive.

gaps.sentence: It's no use ___ about the weather.
gaps.explanation: it's no use + -ing: no use complaining.
Negative infinitive: promised not to be late — 'not' goes before 'to'.
